scope: Two explicitly declared uniform geometric mechanisms; finite hypothesis class, not proof of unique original intended rule.
mechanisms: Copy the visible square template unchanged at every three-dot marker.

If the template is exactly a hollow square outline, remove the non-corner cells from its two sides farthest from the owning missing-corner anchor, then copy that shape at every marker. Other templates remain unchanged.
selection: Every demonstration must match a candidate full output. Query answered only when all surviving candidates agree. No shape-remap dictionary, nearest-owner selection, first tie break, or demo skipping.
geometry: The owning marker is unique. Marker triples explain every marker-colour pixel. Template span2 or3 is guaranteed by unchanged native random domain. All target squares must be in bounds. Copies combine by nonzero-pixel union, including legitimate zero-cell overlap.
